description: Searches the EconDash catalogue by keyword, for example GDP and growth, inflation, unemployment and wages, population, life expectancy, interest and exchange rates, government debt, trade, house prices, oil, gold and metal prices, stock indices, energy, health, education and internet use. Use it when the user asks for a statistic for a country or region: its latest value, history or a comparison. Returns up to 25 matches with the slug, name, unit, frequency, source and years covered. The slug is the input for get_indicator_series, compare_countries and get_indicator_details. The catalogue has no series for individual shares or cryptocurrencies (only the Crypto Fear & Greed Index), tax rates, steel or the Baltic Dry Index.
